rules.name: capesl-takes-cape-off
rules.hint: The side cape is off: cape sleeves are a cape of their own. On a strapless bodice the cape sleeves are detachable: each on its own band round the upper arm.
rules.why: A sheer panel from the upper arm that falls freely behind the arm: to the elbow, the fingertips, the floor or a train. Material, length, edge and flowers under Cape details. Detachable: each on its own band round the upper arm, separate from the bodice.

rules.name: capesl-from-none
rules.why: A sheer panel from the upper arm that falls freely behind the arm: to the elbow, the fingertips, the floor or a train. Material, length, edge and flowers under Cape details.

rules.name: robe-ends-capesl
rules.hint: Cape sleeves are off: the over-robe has its own sleeves.

rules.name: pair-ends-capesl
rules.hint: Cape sleeves are off: the pair of shoulder capes takes their place.

rules.name: robe-flutter
rules.hint: The over-robe is off: it would lie over the flutter sleeves.

rules.name: robe-butterfly
rules.hint: The cape is off: butterfly sleeves stand where it would lie.

rules.name: halter-ends-puff
rules.hint: Sleeves are now none: puff sleeves need both shoulders, and a halter leaves the shoulders bare.

rules.name: one-ends-capesl
rules.hint: Sleeves are now none: cape sleeves need both shoulders, and a one-shoulder gown has only one.

rules.name: one-ends-ruffle
rules.hint: Sleeves are now none: ruffle band sleeves need both shoulders, and a one-shoulder gown has only one.

rules.name: bishop-ends-one
rules.hint: The one-shoulder strap is off: they don't go with this neckline.
rules.why: Long and full, gathered into a fitted cuff at the wrist.

rules.name: ruffle-ends-halter
rules.hint: The halter straps are off: ruffle band need both shoulders. On a strapless bodice the ruffle band are detachable: each on its own band round the upper arm.
rules.why: A gathered ruffle band round each upper arm, joined across the back. Detachable: each on its own band round the upper arm, separate from the bodice.

rules.name: ruffle-moves-neck
rules.hint: The neckline is now off-shoulder: the ruffle band sits on an off-shoulder or sweetheart neckline.
rules.why: A gathered ruffle band round each upper arm, joined across the back.

rules.name: neck-ends-ruffle
rules.hint: The ruffle band is off: it sits on an off-shoulder or sweetheart neckline.

rules.name: terno-juliet
rules.hint: Juliet sleeves now, in place of the butterfly sleeves the Filipiniana comes with.
rules.why: Puffed at the top, then fitted along the forearm to the wrist.

rules.name: terno-ruffle
rules.hint: The neckline is now off-shoulder: the ruffle band sits on an off-shoulder or sweetheart neckline. Ruffle band now, in place of the butterfly sleeves the Filipiniana comes with.
rules.why: A gathered ruffle band round each upper arm, joined across the back.

rules.name: sweetheart-puff
rules.hint: On a strapless bodice the puff sleeves are detachable: each on its own band round the upper arm.
rules.why: Short and full: gathered at the shoulder and into a band above the elbow. Detachable: each on its own band round the upper arm, separate from the bodice.

rules.name: strapless-bishop
rules.hint: A strapless bodice is boned and has a waist stay so it stays up. On a strapless bodice the bishop sleeves are detachable: each on its own band round the upper arm.
rules.why: Long and full, gathered into a fitted cuff at the wrist. Detachable: each on its own band round the upper arm, separate from the bodice.

rules.name: off-juliet-sewn
rules.why: Puffed at the top, then fitted along the forearm to the wrist.

rules.name: v-det-detach
rules.hint: On this neckline the sleeves are already detachable.
rules.why: Short and full: gathered at the shoulder and into a band above the elbow.

rules.name: off-det-detach
rules.why: Short and full: gathered at the shoulder and into a band above the elbow. Detachable: each on its own band round the upper arm, separate from the bodice.

rules.name: capesl-len
rules.why: A sheer panel from the upper arm that falls freely behind the arm: to the elbow, the fingertips, the floor or a train. Material, length, edge and flowers under Cape details.
